verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for a SaaS mail product with an API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents an isolated sandbox or test tenant that keeps production mailbox data out of reach. The only nearby item is Graph Explorer, which lets users try sample REST calls, but nothing says it is isolated from production data, so it is at most an adjacent tool.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
